capabilities: > Pushes selection context to Claude Code
extras: Uses Node's fs module outside the vault API to manage lock files for Claude Code discovery.
intentEvidence: This plugin instead does the resolution server-side, inside Obsidian, using Obsidian's own metadataCache link resolver
problem: Existing integrations require Claude to make multiple round-trips to resolve linked content, leading to inefficient context delivery.
summary: Provides Claude Code with expanded knowledge graph context by pushing resolved links, summaries, and note metadata during text selection.
